subject: 長榮大學校門十字架鐘塔 — 既有原面限域配色
scope: Additive appearance only for the existing gate cross tower, not a new model, not the round Chang Jung Chapel, and not the separately named Shènxíng bell. Geometry and model count are unchanged.
result: No mandatory visual or material-boundary correction. Two same-direction broad faces now carry a restrained light brick-red visual proxy supported by the official aerial photograph. Unsupported surfaces remain neutral.

personal_pixel_review.source: The complete 1024 × 575 official aerial was personally examined. The tower is at the right of the frame; both visible, same-direction broad surfaces are muted red-brown. Narrow sides and top edges are different in illumination/material appearance and were not generalized to red. The round chapel is a separate building and was not used as the tower material reference.
personal_pixel_review.original_preview: The original warm-stone monochrome render was personally examined; it has the same two pierced slabs, existing approximate cross/small openings, two connecting members and plinth. This task does not correct the historical geometric simplifications.
personal_pixel_review.previews/front.png: Both permitted broad faces are colored. Narrow slab edges, hole reveals, connecting members and base remain neutral. Whole geometry fits the frame; a continuous facade color offers clear visual benefit without painting false details.
personal_pixel_review.previews/rear.png: Reverse broad faces remain neutral. Interior shading does not constitute an additional material assignment. No unverified rear-side color is presented.
personal_pixel_review.previews/elevation.png: The positive-X broad elevation carries the limited color while true cross/small openings remain geometry. One slab occludes the other at this orthographic angle; this is not a claim that only one slab exists.
personal_pixel_review.previews/side.png: The two narrow edges and horizontal connections remain neutral, with the real intervening void visible. No clipping of the base or tops.
personal_pixel_review.previews/top.png: Both slab top faces, base and visible connecting surfaces remain neutral. No red top cap or new geometry was added.

independent_findings.original_file_checks: All seven materialized originals were independently checked for byte count, SHA256 and Git blob hash. Original, research and working STL bytes are identical.
independent_findings.mesh_exchange: Direct binary-STL parsing and independent 3MF XML inspection confirm all 500 triangle coordinates, order and winding are exact. One untransformed 3MF mesh, 216 unique vertices, all three material indices per face, and both opaque palette colors match the delivered map.
independent_findings.finite_selection: Reviewer-owned scalar tests inspect every one of the three original vertices and positive-X orientation. Exactly 68 faces lie on x=-5.2 mm and 58 on x=8.8 mm, each within y[-12,12] and z[5,150] mm at epsilon 0.0002 mm. Total selected area is 6744.980026192665 mm². No centroid-only selection, triangle subdivision or interpolation across unsupported material boundaries.
independent_findings.neutral_exclusions: All 374 other original faces remain neutral: opposite broad faces, y-side edges, tops, hole walls, horizontal ties and base.
independent_findings.raw_sanity: Finite coordinates, no zero-area or duplicate triangles, and two opposed incident faces per exact-coordinate edge were independently checked. This is not a full self-intersection, wall-thickness or fabrication certification.
independent_findings.rebuild: The eight delivered 3MF/map/palette/PNG files were independently byte-compared with the builder's separate rebuild directory and match. The reviewer inspected, but did not independently rerun, the builder's strict lib3mf, native Blender material/vertex edit-save-reopen, scene-render and semantic checks.
independent_findings.native_monochrome: The inspected original-native audit reports Printable_CJCU with 500 faces, one Warm stone preview only material and all indices zero. The reviewer independently verified the original scene file byte/blob hashes, but did not rerun that native-scene audit.

dates_and_source_limits.photography: Unknown. Independent PIL inspection confirms EXIF DateTime, DateTimeOriginal and DateTimeDigitized are absent, and raw bytes have no standard XMP markers.
dates_and_source_limits.publication: The official page is dated 2024-04-24 12:08 and describes the gate tower as light brick red. This is a publication date, not a verified capture date. The filename timestamp 20240408114143807 is likewise not a verified shutter time.
dates_and_source_limits.excluded_source: The second official angle campus_adm.jpg returned HTTP 503 during research, was not obtained or viewed, and is not treated as rear-side corroboration. No retry or source download was made in this review.
dates_and_source_limits.color: #AD7868 is an uncalibrated low-saturation visual proxy, not an official color specification or instrument measurement. Weathering, stains and missing surface patches were not reconstructed. Neutral means unconfirmed, not a claim that the real reverse side is gray.
dates_and_source_limits.temporal_scope: Historical source-supported appearance only; no claim of complete 2026 conditions.

manufacturing_limitations: The 500-triangle historical geometry is unchanged, including its approximate holes, ties, proportions and plinth. No claim of a new complete surveyed reconstruction.
No physical-print test, toolpath validation or repeat of historical manufacturing QA. Appearance success does not certify minimum walls or support-free printing.
Both materials are opaque. No transparent image tricks, source-photo projection or private source image assets are part of the delivered model.
release_boundary: Private independent review only. No main-repository changes or publication by reviewer. Reports must be included in checksums and the final backup ZIP, whose actual members require a separate closure check. Any changed bound core or PNG requires renewed review.
